policy.country_semantics: market of the explicitly selected national readonly snapshot, not manufacturing origin
policy.brand_match: exact after normalization; deny takes precedence; country restrictions apply
policy.normalization: Unicode NFKD, remove combining marks, casefold, keep only ASCII a-z0-9
policy.name_match: Unicode NFKD, remove combining marks, casefold, replace punctuation by spaces, collapse whitespace; denied terms match whole phrases
policy.prices: independently generated synthetic values, explicitly labelled as demo prices
policy.limit_note: Conservative allowlist intentionally does not aim to fill the 100000 cap; uncertain and missing brands are skipped.
policy.name_filter_limit: Some retailer names are ordinary words (for example Dia or Mas). Whole-phrase rejection is deliberately conservative and may exclude legitimate manufacturer products; no fuzzy brand inference or padding is used.
